helpCenter.title: Help Center
helpCenter.cantFind: Can't find what you're looking for?
helpCenter.faq_whatIsPopularoo_a: Popularoo is the first real-time popularity index for public figures. Vote on your favorite personalities, discover who's trending, and watch rankings shift in real time. Every vote counts — and your voice shapes the Popularoo Index.
helpCenter.faq_popularooIndex_a:
The Popularoo Index is a live score assigned to every personality in the app. It captures community votes, momentum over the last 24 hours, and how consistently a personality engages the audience over time. Think of it as a real-time pulse on public opinion.

The exact formula is kept under wraps — but the more votes and engagement a personality receives, the higher their Index climbs.
helpCenter.faq_superlike_a:
A Superlike is a high-impact vote that counts more than a regular vote. It's free, but limited: you can give one Superlike per personality per day. Use them to show strong support and to help trigger Strikes for your favorite outsiders.

Use them strategically. Choose who deserves your daily Superlike, and watch the momentum build.
helpCenter.faq_boosters_a:
Boosters let you appear in the Outsiders ranking. Each tier offers different durations:

• Booster (€0.99) — 1 hour in Outsiders
• Super Booster (€9.99) — 24 hours in Outsiders
• Golden Booster (€49.99) — 7 days with priority placement, Home page rotation as Outsider of the Day, and premium features
helpCenter.faq_vote_a:
Search for a personality or tap on one from the lists. On their page, tap the thumbs up or thumbs down button. You can vote once every 24 hours per personality.

Each vote contributes permanently to the score. Votes don't cancel each other out — they accumulate over time, like the variations of a stock price.
helpCenter.faq_potd_q: What is Personality of the Day?
helpCenter.faq_potd_a: Every day, the personality with the highest Popularoo Index over the last 24 hours gets highlighted. It refreshes automatically each day at midnight (UTC). Both celebrities and Outsiders with an active Booster can earn this title — it all depends on voter engagement!
helpCenter.faq_addPerson_q: Can I add a new personality to the ranking?
helpCenter.faq_addPerson_a:
It depends on what you're looking to do:

• To add a missing celebrity (for example your favourite artist or an athlete you'd like to see): use the search bar on the home page. If the person isn't listed yet, Popularoo automatically searches Wikipedia and adds them to the database. It's free and instant.

• To add yourself to the ranking: activate a Booster from the Premium page to become an Outsider. You'll then appear alongside celebrities for the duration of your Booster (1h, 24h or 7 days depending on the tier you choose). That's how the Popularoo community grows with new faces every day.
helpCenter.faq_contact_a: Send an email to {{email}} and we'll get back to you within 24 hours.
helpCenter.faq_privacy_a: Yes. We use a device-based anonymous ID. We don't collect personal data unless you choose to provide it in your Account page or when purchasing a Booster.
